steps.en: Review the pinned example and prepare the Rust/tool-server environment
steps.zh: 审阅固定示例，准备Rust与工具服务器环境

steps.en: Start the local gateway with the documented example configuration
steps.zh: 按文档示例配置启动本地网关

steps.en: Accept MCP traffic and initialize the configured target
steps.zh: 接收MCP流量并初始化所配目标

steps.en: Connect an authorized client and list or call a tool
steps.zh: 让获准客户端连接并列出或调用工具

steps.en: Apply configured policy and relay tool messages and results
steps.zh: 应用已配策略，转发工具消息及结果

value.en: One MCP-facing entry point; identity policy and tool isolation remain explicit work
value.zh: 提供一个MCP入口；身份策略与工具隔离仍须明确配置
